scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-178
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-179 defines the disabled dense-linear caller-output-storage runtime gate only.
No runtime behavior changes are made in this slice.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 claim is made.
The gate cannot be enabled until both API capability and paired strict Qwen3/Qwen2.5 before/after receipt evidence exist.

consumed_classification.reason: SLM-CPU-178 found that dense-linear read-side state is inspectable, but production compute returns owned Candle Tensor outputs and helper-local output slices cannot cross the returned-Tensor boundary.

required_api_capabilities.reason: Tensor::matmul returns an owned Tensor and exposes no caller-provided output storage parameter.
Tensor::broadcast_add returns an owned Tensor and exposes no caller-provided output storage parameter for optional dense-linear bias.
Tensor::from_vec consumes owned Vec storage, and downstream transformer stages currently require Candle Tensor semantics after dense-linear output.
No typed fused consumer currently owns the post-dense-linear Tensor consumers, residual/norm boundaries, trace identity, and receipt-safe generated behavior.

allowed_future_implementation_shapes: Candle exposes matmul_out and broadcast_add_out style APIs that fill caller-provided output storage while preserving Tensor semantics.
The repo adds a typed fused dense-linear consumer that owns every downstream consumer stage and avoids returned Tensor materialization.
A backend-local helper remains trace-only or receipt-gated until the strict cross-model evidence gate proves unchanged generated behavior.
explicit_non_solutions: Skipping bias in a no-bias tensor path does not solve matmul's owned Tensor output.
Filling a helper-local Vec or host slice does not solve the returned Candle Tensor boundary.
Promoting source-order or packed-Q8 helper paths to default runtime is not allowed by this gate.
A single-model receipt is not enough to enable the gate.

measurement_fields_required_before_any_i: phase timing for affected warm-session prompts
thermal/power fields as measured or explicitly unavailable
failure_policy: If either model changes generated_ids, decoded_text, backend identity, tokenizer authority, or fallback status, the gate remains disabled.
If allocation counters or timing fields are absent, the gate may preserve behavior but cannot claim allocation or timing improvement.
If API capability is still missing, the gate remains disabled even if a helper-local output slice exists.

runtime_status_after_slm_cpu_179.selected_next_frontier_reason: The disabled gate is now explicit; future work must either produce real output-storage APIs or a typed fused consumer plus paired strict receipt evidence before runtime promotion.

must_not_claim: SLM-CPU-179 enables dense-linear caller-output storage by default.
SLM-CPU-179 proves allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, or sustained throughput.
Candle Tensor matmul, broadcast_add, final-norm, residual-add, output-head, or model.forward caller-output-storage blockers are resolved.
A no-bias fast path solves the output-storage boundary.
Packed-Q8 or source-order sidecar paths are promoted to default runtime.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
